sources.title: Lucasgitguy-co/forma3d-tiny · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Forma3D-Tiny v0.2 An experimental compact image-to-Gaussian model post-trained from Image3D Student's synthetic demonstration checkpoint. This is a coarse research baseline, not a general-purpose photo-to-3D model. Its grid is 16 cubed and it has 306,321 parameters. Selected checkpoint: step 4800; completed run: 5000 steps.
